headline: Approved Farrell as chairman, Goodwin as vice-chair, and Imbracsio as recorder by 7-0 vote.
summary: The meeting covered the Haunted Tunnel food donation bins, pickleball locations, and October events. Racist stickers were placed on windows at the Carousel and throughout the Park, and police apprehended an offender.
decisions: Approved Farrell as Chairman, Goodwin as Vice-Chair, and Imbracsio as Recorder, 7-0.
plain_text:
Pawtucket Parks Commission Meeting Minutes 
 
 
 
Start Time:    9/8/26 7:03 
 
Roll Call:  In attendance – Commission members:  Chairman Farrell, Imbracsio, Allen, 
Degre-Markley, Tierney, Goodwin, Nese 
 
 
 City Representative: Luke Mcglaughlin 
         
  
 Excused Absence Commissioner(s): Minton  
 Not present: Commissioner(s):  
   
Minutes approval –    
1st Motion by Commissioner :  Allen 
2nd Motion by Commissioner:   Degre-Markley  in favor =     against =  0 
 
 
Public Input:  Per a correspondence received by the Pawtucket City Clerk’s Office on April 1, 2022, 
Mayor Grebien has requested that a Zoom meeting format continue in order for the public to view meetings.  
Committee members are required to be present at these meetings. 
 
 
CHAIR UPDATE:  
• Announcement that Mary Healey has resigned from her position on the Parks Commission 
• Nominations for Parks Commission officers:  
o Farrell for Chairman –Nominated by Imbracsio, seconded by Degre-Markley 
o Goodwin for Vice-Chair – Nominated by Allen, seconded by Imbracsio 
o Imbracsio for Recorder – Nominated by Goodwin, seconded by Tierney 
o All nominations were unanimously approved (7 – 0) 
 
• Haunted Tunnel opens 10/2/26 
o Parks Commission to have a food donation drop-off bin in place at the Haunted Tunnel, Parks and 
Recreation office at Slater Park, and the DPW Office –  
▪ All donations will benefit the Pawtucket soup kitchen 
▪ Imbracsio to send info to Luke for flyer design 
• Discussion of Pickleball meeting – further discussion in review of old business 
• Checkerboard damage at Slater Park – Luke to follow up 
 
REVIEW OLD BUSINESS  
• John Street Park to be done in October   
• Discussion and presentation of the Pickleball locations 
o Imbracsio to send Luke the info for review – packet and details of the area behind Len’s 
• Review of the Slater Park Arts Festival  
o Music was very receptive 
o Sunday was light but overall great turn out 
• October events 
o No pumpkins in the park 
▪ Looking to supplement something for the kids, possibly pumpkin painting
o Haunted tunnel is ready to go 
o Sports in the park picking up - cross country 
• Parks and Rec update 
o Racist stickers stuck on all windows at the Carousel and throughout the Park 
▪ As was Luke was cleaning, they stuck more on, he had to call police. 
▪ Offender was apprehended by police 
o All other events have had great turnout 
o Tree update 
▪ Kyle will be handling all tree works in the fall/winter 
 
 
OPEN FORUM  
•  
 
 
Motion to adjourn: 
1st Motion by Commissioner Allen 
2nd Motion by Commissioner Marklety 
 
 
End time:     7:47 pm
